source.name: 腾讯新闻·九五体育 (Tencent News): 三大行业，成为中超球队胸前广告的赞助商
source.quote: 另一个房地产赞助商是北京国安足球俱乐部的胸前广告——中赫集团。
source.note: Translation: 'The other property sponsor is Beijing Guoan FC's front-of-shirt advertisement — Sinobo Group.' The same article's survey of all 16 CSL clubs' 2026 chest ads names nothing else for Beijing Guoan. Chinese press (Sohu, MSN China, Toutiao) report that JD.com's three-season front deal ended when it chose not to renew for 2026, and the club's owner Sinobo took the chest back.

source.name: Footy Headlines: 2026 Chinese Super League Kits - All Releases So Far
source.quote: Nike has officially unveiled the 2026 Home Kits for all 16 teams competing in the Chinese Super League (CSL).
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The article shows the Beijing Guoan home kit in its own section; oldfootballshirts.com's 2026 Beijing Guoan home shirt entry also states 'Manufactured by Nike'.

summary: 2026 home kit (Nike, launched 28 January 2026). Front sponsor is 中赫集团 (Sinobo Group), the club's owner, per Tencent News' survey of all 16 CSL clubs' 2026 chest sponsors; JD.com's front-of-shirt deal ended after three seasons when it did not renew for 2026. Back, sleeve and shorts placements could not be verified for 2026 from sources we could open (footballkitarchive.com 403s; the club's own site was unreachable at check time), so the list is not marked complete.
